HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Textiles 3.1 Yarns and Fabrics 3.2 Pattern Blocks and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Budgeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Yarns and Fabrics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
